text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay, yay-yay! First place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible! I'm so 
aaawesooome!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Amazing, right! I mean, it's 1st 
place! First place!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Urara-chaaan! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's everyone from the shopping 
district! Helloooo, helloooo♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to cook up some celebratory 
red bean rice tonight!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'll take some extra chewy rice, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, they're so happy! I'm glad I took 
1st place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I run more, will you smile even more? 
Hey, hey, when's the next race?!
choice_data_list: Is there a race you want to run, Urara?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? As long as I can run, anything works 
for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just the answer I expected. Though I'd 
really like to hear Haru Urara talk about 
her target race soon...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, when it comes to aiming for the 
Arima Kinen, the races Haru Urara should 
enter right now are limited."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's only a 100-meter difference from this 
race, but it might be a good chance to 
test if she can break through the mile 
barrier. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it—!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I should let everyone in the shopping 
district know that the Elm Stakes is next.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, really!? Then it might be impossible 
since it's so far away~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well, who cares! I took 1st place 
today anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm center stage for the concert 
too! I'm gonna dance with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off to get ready for the 
concert!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing Haru Urara off back to the 
waiting room, I headed to the backstage of 
the Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah, there are so many people! Maybe I 
should do a few extra spins than usual!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm the center today! I'm gonna twirl and 
spin even more than usual~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah—huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the direction Haru Urara is looking, 
there's an Umamusume with a gloomy 
expression. If I recall correctly, she ran 
in the same race today.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Urara-chan... Yeah, I'm... okay.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why the sad face, though? You're about to 
put on a concert—aren't you excited?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, everyone's eagerly waiting for you! 
Just like always, with a big smile—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can laugh about this...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even though I got the chance to run in a 
GⅠ...! It was my big chance, and I let it 
slip away!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to stand at center stage. But I 
couldn't, because of my own lack of 
ability...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And yet, there's no way I can smile. I'm 
so frustrated, so frustrated... that I 
just can't smile!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Frustrated...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...S-Sorry, it's nothing. Don't worry, 
once it starts, I'll smile properly.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Next time, I'm definitely... 
standing in the center!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...They left.
choice_data_list: Is she a friend of yours?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She's always smiling, and she's so 
gentle and sweet...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I've never seen her like that before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara looks utterly dumbfounded. 
Seeing this new side of her friend might 
have given her something to think about in 
her own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However...
choice_data_list: The live show's about to start!
The live show's about to start soon!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right! All right, let's do 
this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara bounced back to her usual self 
and headed off toward the stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the latter half of the concert, as 
I approached the audience side, I spotted 
Special Week, who had come to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Urara-chan's Trainer! Good evening!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan looks like she's having so much 
fun dancing! Just watching her gives me 
energy too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I just love Urara-chan's 
concerts!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is certainly right; Haru 
Urara's charm lies in her boundless 
cheerfulness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is why everyone loves Haru Urara. 
Even if she loses, even if she cannot win, 
they love seeing her cheerful smile.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-chan is really working hard, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
I want to see that smile on the Arima 
Kinen stage too. I really hope she 
enters...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, hearing a familiar voice, I 
turned around to see folks from the 
shopping district talking about something 
as they watched the concert.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, at this rate, she won't be able to 
run in the Arima Kinen, right? Man, I 
really want to let her run...”

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's anything we can do...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Urara-chan's Trainer! It looks like 
they're about to wrap up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When you get back, please tell Urara-chan 
that I really enjoyed the concert!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although I was worried about the folks 
from the shopping district, just as 
Special Week said, we promptly headed back 
to the waiting room.
